Australia GDP Growth Tops Expectations
articles.expand: Australia's economy logged a stronger-than-expected growth in the second quarter, raising prospects of interest rate hikes by the Reserve Bank of Australia. Gross domestic product grew 2.1 percent from the previous year, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said Wednesday. This was slower than first quarter's 2.5 percent expansion but better than forecast of 1.8 percent.

articles.title: Swiss bankers expect SNB to maintain zero policy rate through to next year
articles.expand: The survey showed that all the Swiss bankers surveyed are expecting the SNB to keep its policy rate at 0% for the rest of this year. The remaining respondents on the other side of that balance are expecting the SNB to start hiking interest rates in 2027 instead.
